###
Frequently Asked Questions About Hermanus 2026
When and where is Hermanus 2026 being held?
Hermanus 2026 takes place on Fri, 27 Nov, 2026 at 10:00 am to Sun, 29 Nov, 2026 at 05:00 pm at Rotary Way, Hermanus, 7200, South Africa.
Who is organizing Hermanus 2026?
Hermanus 2026 is organized by Two Oceans Slope Soarers.
